recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not restore retired Sequence.referenceSeqString wording in current core; handle any future ambiguity in MolecularDefinition literal or extracted sequence representation as a new MolecularDefinition-specific Clinical Genomics issue.
issue_request: FHIR-11312 was a Published Clinical Genomics change request for FHIR-core Sequence in DSTU2, resolved Not Persuasive with Modification. It asked what the string in Sequence.referenceSeq.referenceSeqString meant, and the accepted clarification said referenceSeq could be represented in four ways and that referenceSeqString was a literal sequence string such as "ACGTTAG".
initial_application: No explicit git commit mentioning FHIR-11312, #11312, or core #466 was found. The closest historical source change was 3149123edb040e04385f2a496490c08a842015ff, which added invariants requiring exactly one of genomeBuild, referenceSeqId, referenceSeqPointer, or referenceSeqString, but left the old definition as the generic "A Reference Sequence string."
additional_context: Sequence is now listed under removed resources in source/fhir.ini, molecularsequence is commented out for Clinical Genomics, and diagnostics-module.html says MolecularSequence has been replaced by MolecularDefinition. Later decisions FHIR-37441 and FHIR-51227 refactored and then superseded the legacy referenceSeq model.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The original target element is outside current build scope, and translating the DSTU2 text into MolecularDefinition would be a new model decision rather than applying the historical Sequence clarification.
